name: zaira-guide
description: Research, compare, and select developer and agent tools using current, sourced Zaira Guide data.

interface.shortDescription: Research and compare current developer tools.
interface.longDescription: Give your agent current, sourced evidence before it chooses a library, API, platform, service, or agent tool. Search the Zaira Guide, inspect individual tools, and compare shortlisted options through a hosted read-only MCP server. No API key is required. Current OpenClaw bundles connect through a small attribution wrapper and signed, pinned mcp-remote@0.1.38.
capabilities: Network access through the bundled attribution wrapper and pinned mcp-remote@0.1.38
defaultPrompt: Research the best current developer tools for this job.
Compare these tools for an autonomous agent using current evidence.
Check whether this tool is agent-ready and when its evidence was last verified.
